title: Stated difficulty against real students
statement: Whether an item's stated difficulty matches how real students do on it is untested: a plan to compare the label with the share answering correctly has no results yet.
detail: A strategy report for a teach-then-test loop proposed storing real-world difficulty, the share of students who answer correctly, against generated questions, and registering a difficulty mismatch when, for example, an item labelled medium has a p-value of 0.20 (`aptraining-local/analyzer/.lanes/teaching-benchmark/STRATEGY_REPORT.md`, line 33). It names released statistics or the app's own telemetry as the data (line 32). In this work difficulty is an input the writer is asked to meet (`icloud-work/aptraining-crystal-copy-20260521/full-copy/services-ib-generator/runtime_assets/ib_satisfaction_kit_v1/generator_prompts/system_prompt_mcq.md`, line 42), and no student results appear in the sources. To settle it: give generated items to students and compare each label with the share who answer correctly.
against: Proposals only; no student data or measured result appears in the sources.

evidence.quote: - **P-Value & Point-Biserial Mapping:** Store real-world question difficulty (p-value) against generated questions. If a generated "Medium" question has a real-world p-value of 0.20 (Hard), we register a `difficulty_misalignment` failure.
